resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Ravalli County firelookout.com page gives abandonment in 1973. The main firelookout.com page and montanalookouts.weebly.com give destruction or removal in 1975. The story reports both.
The firelookout.com list runs Bessie Sopher from 1953 to 1962, but the June 1962 Ravalli Republic item calls that season her 12th on the lookout, which implies a start in 1951.
One page calls the tower wooden and the other calls it pole. Both give a 30-foot L-4 tower built in 1940.

sources.title: Thunder Mtn. Fire Lookout Tower (Ravalli County page)

notes_for_editor: The two firelookout.com pages for this tower disagree on the end date (1973 abandoned versus 1975 destroyed) and on the wooden or pole design. Sopher's tenure is inconsistent between the list and the 1962 item. The 7,699 ft elevation has no schema key, so it appears in the story only. No fire record was found. Do not confuse with the Thunder Mountain in Lincoln County (45.57957 is Ravalli; 48.80818 -116.00056 is Lincoln), a separate tower on the same list.
